summary: Full pass over the 4 new features: parts/rental/collision (Body Shop) departments, per-department Shop Leaderboard on monthly report, rep 'Got it' coaching acknowledgement, and Monday Coaching Digest. Backend sanity 6/7 (1 skipped only because ack-403 test couldn't discover an evaluation id from open endpoints - covered indirectly by frontend which confirms managers get NO eval-ack-btn). Frontend A-F all verified end-to-end.

issues: Body Shop department section/chip is not rendered on the client's Challenges tab when the client has no Body Shop reps assigned yet. Library and Generator sheet DO include Body Shop chip and 3 collision starter challenges. If the spec intended Body Shop chip to always appear on the client challenges tab regardless of headcount, this is a gap; otherwise this is by-design (chip only renders when at least one rep is in that dept). Flagging for confirmation.

action_items: Confirm intended behavior for Body Shop dept chip on the client Challenges tab when the client has no rep in that department (currently hidden). Same likely applies to Rental filter chip on the Report tab (rental had no shops, so report-filter-dept-rental was not rendered).
critical_code_review_comments: report-filter-clear testid only renders when a filter is currently active (verified). This is fine but may surprise future tests looking for a persistent Clear affordance.
PDF export uses FlateDecode-compressed streams, so raw byte grep for 'Sales leaderboard' will fail; assertion should target %PDF header + Content-Type.
